name: Lungs of the Earth
source:
"Some people like to call us heroes... Y'know. Saving lives. Hunting monsters. The family business."

In a Cyberpunk Fantasy world, a trio of unlikely heroes work together to make ends meet in the city of Requiem. A mash-up of Cyberpunk meets High Fantasy in an explicit, gore-tastic, hilarious, and sexy mess where your choice dictates how your story plays out. Our heroes like to kick ass and eat ass.… And they're all outta ass.

[From [url=https://asphyxia-dynamics.itch.io/lungs-of-the-earth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“有些人喜欢称我们为英雄……你知道。拯救生命。猎杀怪物。家族事业。”

在赛博朋克奇幻世界中，三名看似不太可能的英雄齐心协力，在安魂曲市维持生计。赛博朋克与高级幻想的混搭，在一种露骨、血腥、搞笑和性感的混乱中，你的选择决定了你的故事如何发展。我们的英雄喜欢踢屁股、吃屁股……而且他们都疯了。

[来自[url=https://asphyxia-dynamics.itch.io/lungs-of-the-earth]Itch.io[/url]]
